summary: A Meta Superintelligence Labs researcher announced the launch of Muse Image, MSL's first media generation model that uses reasoning, refinement and tools with test-time scaling, alongside a preview of Muse Video.

mechanisms.reason: The model reportedly uses test-time scaling, meaning more compute is spent per generation, which would raise inference volume/compute per task if adopted at scale.
mechanisms.quote: Muse image can use reasoning, refinement, and tools to improve precision and quality, with very clear test time scaling trends.

practices.reason: A new first-party media generation model is described as using reasoning, refinement and tool use, which would be worth evaluating for image/video generation workloads.
practices.quote: Muse image can use reasoning, refinement, and tools to improve precision and quality, with very clear test time scaling trends.
